about_item: 🎵 BALANCED TUNES WITH BONE CONDUCTION | Powerful audio that doesn’t trap you in. These bone conduction headphones use advanced technology to deliver clear, balanced sound through vibration instead of in-ear pressure. Enjoy music comfortably with headphones that reduce ear fatigue and irritation.

👂 OPEN-EAR DESIGN FOR SAFER LISTENING | Traditional headphones block your awareness, but these conduction headphones keep your ears completely open. Designed as open ear headphones wireless bluetooth, they help you stay alert and connected to your surroundings—ideal for commuting, workout headphones, and everyday use.

🏃 BUILT FOR RUNNING & ACTIVE LIFESTYLES | Designed as reliable running headphones, these bone conduction headphones bluetooth stay secure while you move. Whether you’re training outdoors, walking the city, or hitting the gym, these bone headphones deliver consistent sound without slowing you down. With an IP68 rating rain, sweat, storms, and spills won’t stop your music, built to play in all conditions.

🪶 LIGHTWEIGHT & ERGONOMIC BUILD | Easy on your ears and designed for extended wear, these bone conduction head phones feature a featherlight frame with an ergonomic fit. Move freely all day while enjoying the comfort and stability of modern conduction headphones.
🎚️ ADJUSTABLE BONE CONDUCTION EARBUDS | Slide the ear buds closer for louder sound or pull them back to increase environmental awareness, letting you control the way you listen—your sound, your way.

summary.text: Customers find the bone conduction headphones have good sound quality, allowing them to hear their surroundings, and appreciate their functionality for work calls. The comfort and fit receive mixed feedback - while some find them extremely comfortable for all-day wear and stay nicely in place, others report pain from ill-fitting earpieces. The battery life and value for money also get mixed reviews, with some praising the amazing battery life while others find it horrible, and while some consider them worth the price, others say they're not worth it. The proprietary charging cable is a significant drawback for many customers.
